title: The Hidden Cost of Saying Yes to Everyone Except Yourself
hook: The Hidden Cost of Saying Yes to E

scenes.narration: The Hidden Cost of Saying Yes to Everyone Except Yourself?
Sit with that for a second. The Hidden Cost of Saying Yes to Everyone Except Yourself.
It sounds small. But follow it, and it changes how today feels.
We move through our days mostly on autopilot, barely noticing.
And the quiet truths are the ones we skip right past.
Think of someone close to you. Picture them clearly.
Now think of how rarely you really stop and look.
Time keeps moving whether or not you're paying attention.
Zoom out far enough and the small worries go quiet.
Zoom back in, and what's left is what actually matters.
There's a version of you that already lives this way.
Calmer. Kinder to themselves. More awake to the moment.
And the gap between you and them is just a handful of choices.
You don't have to fix everything tonight.
You just have to notice a little more than you did yesterday.
Because you only get so many ordinary days. And they're not ordinary at all.
